item.title: Go Daily Question 211
item.description:
Go101 author published an interesting problem that primarily tests subtle details, a characteristic for which the book Go101 is well-known. Let’s look at this problem: what is the output of the following program? (Single choice)

package main

const s = "Go101.org"

// len(s) == 9
// 1 << 9 == 512
// 512 / 128 == 4

var a byte = 1 << len(s) / 128
var b byte = 1 << len(s[:]) / 128

func main() {
    println(a, b)
}
  • A、0 0
  • B、0 4
  • C：4 0
  • D：4 4
